₿ CRYPTO EXPANSION: Interactive Brokers adds Solana, XRP, Cardano, and Dogecoin to its trading platform, doubling its crypto offerings to eight, The Block reports on March 26, 2025.
https://t.co/RDPLfRQg3R

⚖️ DOGECOIN MINING GETS SERIOUS: SEC clarifies that Dogecoin and Bitcoin proof-of-work mining doesn’t violate securities laws, signaling a shift as mining gains traction, Decrypt reports on March 20, 2025.  
https://t.co/DDrLhmmUSN
⚡️ UPDATE: Elon Musk clarifies that the U.S. Department of Government Efficiency (D.O.G.E.) has no intention of using Dogecoin. https://t.co/EI1eCkPKPv

🚨 ELON MUSK: "No plans for the government to use Dogecoin or anything like that.  

I wanted to call it the Government Efficiency Commission, but that’s dull. The internet pushed for Department of Government Efficiency—and I agree, the internet nailed it."

🚨 CRYPTO REBOUND: XRP and Dogecoin Soar 10% as Bitcoin Nears $80K in Broad Market Relief Rally.  
https://t.co/dEeYSZ7cUn

🇺🇸 Fund issuers push for U.S. spot ETFs tracking Dogecoin, XRP, Solana, and Trump’s meme coin, following Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF approvals, with Solana ETFs likely delayed until 2026 due to SEC reviews and litigation, Decrypt reports on April 21, 2025.
